name: Edomites The
overview: The Edomites are identified in Scripture as the descendants of Esau, also called Edom, with their leadership structured under various dukes, such as those from Eliphaz, Reuel, and Aholibamah, Esau's wives, as detailed in Genesis 36:15-19. They inhabited the land of Edom, also known as Mount Seir, and had a distinct tribal organization. The genealogies emphasize their close familial relationship to Israel, being the brethren of Israel through Esau, highlighting a shared ancestry but distinct national identity.
